base.story: Hits YE26 ARR ~$8B, guides YE27 ARR ~$15-18B; deploys ~1 GW in 2027 with some delays; moderate dilution (~5-8%); multiple compresses from ~8x to ~5x forward ARR, offsetting growth - stock roughly flat.

bull.story: YE27 ARR guide $20B+, $40-50M/MW short-term pricing sticks, ClickHouse IPO crystallises value, financing mostly via prepayments/ABS so dilution is light; market keeps 7-8x forward ARR.

thesis_break_reason: At ~$110 the equity (~$36B, EV ~$34B) would be priced at roughly my base DCF and ~2x YE27 ARR - the market would be pricing failed 2027 deployment/financing, contract cancellations or a collapse in GPU-hour pricing rather than ordinary volatility (it sits below the March-2026 pre-breakout range and well below the 2026 drawdown lows of $146).

reasoning: Facts: Q2'26 revenue $582M (+454%), AI-cloud adj. EBITDA margin 50%, ARR $3.0B, FY26 guide revenue $3.0-3.4B / ARR $7-9B / capex $20-25B, >$9B prepayments expected, $8.0B cash vs $8.5B debt, 271.9M shares + ITM converts and an active ATM. Valuation: an explicit DCF (Kilian's request) gives only ~$100/sh at 13% WACC ($76-117 for 12-15%) because GPU clouds need ~$1.2 of capex per $ of new revenue and a full GPU refresh every ~5 years, so terminal FCF is thin; the market price embeds an ARR-multiple framework. EV/forward ARR versus CoreWeave (~4.5x YE26 ARR, stock -36% in 12m despite +112% revenue growth and $104B backlog) at a 5x premium-ish multiple on YE27 ARR $17B gives ~$245. Blended FV $187. Base rates: NBIS itself had two ~50% drawdowns in the past 12 months (Oct-Dec 2025, Jun-Jul 2026) and +107% 1y return - realized vol 106%; extreme-volatility/lottery stocks have historically had below-average forward returns (Ang et al.), while 12m momentum is a mild positive; the closest peer (CRWV) de-rated sharply as capex/dilution rose. Macro: 10y at 5.29% and a September Fed hike (Kalshi 33% another in Oct) are headwinds for long-duration AI infra; Polymarket gives 8% AI-bubble-burst by Dec-26 and ~18% by Jun-27 (thin volume $9k for that leg; total market $3.0M). I build the 12m ladder as an average of (a) a three-scenario lognormal mixture (bear $105-110/30%, base $230/45%, bull $400/25%) and (b) a single lognormal with median ~$215 and sigma 0.85 (vol shrunk from 106% realized toward a typical decay), giving a median ~$222, mean near spot, and a fat left tail. Research limited by Twelve Data paywall (no consensus estimates/targets) and Alpha Vantage rate limit; no option data used.
